name: bm-e4-feedback-predictions
title: E4 — New feedback predictions
question: When do growth-driven turnover, spatial BM heterogeneity, contractility-dependent confinement, partial adhesion and network failure change cell height and lumenoid growth beyond the original paper?
hypothesis: With one-way, uncoupled and uniform-material controls, the fully coupled system predicts regimes - growth-driven turnover, spatial BM heterogeneity, contractility-dependent confinement, partial adhesion/network failure - in which cell height and lumenoid growth depart measurably from the paper's homogeneous, one-way predictions.
objective: Test growth-driven turnover, spatial BM heterogeneity, contractility-dependent confinement, partial adhesion and network failure, each against one-way, uncoupled and uniform-material controls, and report where the bidirectionally coupled predictions depart from the paper.
description:
The novel-prediction extension (plan section 5, E4) and the end state of the campaign. Each
new feedback hypothesis (growth-driven turnover, spatial BM heterogeneity, contractility-
dependent confinement, partial adhesion, network failure) is tested against matched one-way
/ uncoupled / uniform-material controls so that any departure from the paper is attributable
to the mechanism rather than to added complexity. These are predictions, explicitly
distinguished from reproductions.

expected_behavior.name: coupled-departs-from-controls
expected_behavior.observable: cell height / lumenoid growth vs matched controls
expected_behavior.condition: full coupling vs one-way / uncoupled / uniform-material
expected_behavior.rationale: A measurable, control-isolated departure from the paper's one-way homogeneous prediction is the deliverable; null results against controls are reported, not hidden.

baseline.name: bm-e4-feedback-predictions
baseline.note: Implemented as the bidirectional LAMMPS<->Tyssue coupling (the P3 capstone): the lumenoid epithelium's basal BM-shell surface stretches an explicit LAMMPS collagen IV BM patch, whose stress feeds back as a basal tension on the epithelium. Resolves ready and RUNS the force round-trip (verified: basal area -> BM strain -> BM stress ~0.9..43 -> basal tension -> epithelium; lumen pressure evolves). v0 single-lumenoid patch, bidirectional; the one-way / uncoupled / uniform-material controls + convergence verification build on this.
